definitions.gloss: specific remedy; sure cure; silver bullet
definitions.explanation: A medicine that works especially well against one particular illness. Figuratively, a quick and certain solution to a problem, and very often used in the negative: there is no magic cure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特効薬|とっこうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There is no cure for the common cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{特効薬|とっこうやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new specific remedy has been developed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特効薬|とっこうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、さまざまな⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせる→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧。
examples.english: There's no silver bullet for the falling birth rate; the only way is to combine many policies.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {特効薬|とっこうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no magic cure
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特効薬|とっこうやく}: a sure cure for ~ (⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特効薬|とっこうやく}, a cure for the recession)
- {特効薬|とっこうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for a quick fix

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {万能薬|ばんのうやく}: cure-all, panacea; works for everything, not one thing
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine in general
